conceptual_change: Shift from price/volume trend intensity indicators to a volatility-normalized z-score of raw volume to identify periods of unusually low volume activity relative to the recent rolling window, serving as a contrarian signal for potential mean reversion in trendless or exhausted market regimes.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
